email_not_configured: This server can't send email yet. Ask its admin to set it up.
email_not_verified: Confirm your email address first, with the code we sent you.
email_taken: This email address is already in use.
email_unchanged: This is already your email address.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
incorrect_credentials: Wrong username, email address or password.
internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again later.
@internal_error: Any failure inside the server; the details are only in the server's log.
invalid_email: This doesn't look like an email address.
invalid_or_expired_code: This code is wrong or has expired.
invalid_request: The server couldn't read this request. Updating the app may help.
@invalid_request: The app sent something the server doesn't understand, usually because the app is outdated.
invalid_setup_code: The setup code is wrong. You find it in the server's log.
@invalid_setup_code: Only the very first sign-up on a new server needs this code.
last_admin: The last admin can't become a member.
@last_admin: The server always keeps at least one admin.
method_not_allowed: The server doesn't support this here.
@method_not_allowed: The app called the server in a way it doesn't offer, usually because the app is outdated.
@not_implemented: The server knows this feature but doesn't have it yet.
password_unchanged: The new password is the same as the current one.
too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
@too_many_attempts: The app may show how long to wait next to it.
totp_setup_not_pending: There's no two-factor setup to confirm. Start the setup again.
unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
@unauthorized: The app then returns to the login screen.
